definition: C. A, with the CMS 2024 coverage model

definition: F. Every non-citizen in the ACS, counted

definition: G. F, with the upper-bound coverage model

definition: H. F plus every US-born person living with a non-citizen

definition: H'. F plus US-born children under 18 living with a non-citizen

basis: NATIVITY==2; about half are naturalised US citizens
